scope: 28 exercise records, five 01-owned programme templates, evidence ledger, and visual-source manifest.

source_policy.exercise_taxonomy_license: Unlicense, public-domain dedication. Verify individual media provenance before shipping any source image.
source_policy.product_visual_policy: Reference images are development seeds only. Production 01 exercise visuals must be original, rights-audited, and accessible.

evidence_records.title: American College of Sports Medicine Position Stand: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults
evidence_records.use: Baseline resistance-training prescription and progression guardrails.

evidence_records.title: Progression Models in Resistance Training for Healthy Adults
evidence_records.use: Progression models, loading, repetition ranges, and rest considerations.

evidence_records.title: Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass
evidence_records.use: Volume should progress rather than start maximal.

evidence_records.title: Resistance Training Load Effects on Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gain
evidence_records.use: Load selection: strength is more specific to heavier loads, while hypertrophy can occur across loads when effort is appropriate.

evidence_records.title: Effects of resistance training performed to repetition failure or non-failure on muscular strength and hypertrophy
evidence_records.use: Failure is an option, not a default requirement.

evidence_records.title: Influence of Resistance Training Proximity-to-Failure on Skeletal Muscle Hypertrophy
evidence_records.use: RIR is a useful user-facing autoregulation input, with individual uncertainty.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Keep the load balanced over the mid-foot and use a controlled depth you can own.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Stop and choose a tolerated alternative if pain occurs or control is lost.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Keep the weight close, stay balanced through the whole foot, and stand with control.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a pain-free depth and change the movement if needed.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Keep hips and back supported. Lower only as far as you can control without the pelvis rolling.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Do not force range or load through joint pain.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Move the hips back, keep the load close, and stop the descent when your position changes.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a reduced range or alternative if symptoms increase. Do not diagnose pain in-app.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Keep the hips anchored and control both directions.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a comfortable range and avoid jerking.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Pause briefly with control, then lower without dropping the weight.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Avoid painful range or aggressive lockout.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Use a controlled stretch and full comfortable rise, without bouncing.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Reduce range if the foot or ankle becomes painful.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Keep a stable upper back and lower the bar with control to a repeatable touch point.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use safety arms or a spotter when appropriate. Replace if shoulder pain occurs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Keep wrists stacked over elbows and press through a controlled path.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a comfortable range and avoid painful shoulder positions.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cue: Use a moderate incline and a smooth press without shrugging.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Change the bench angle or exercise if shoulder pain occurs.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull the elbows down and control the return. Do not swing the torso.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a grip and range that remain comfortable at the shoulders.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cue: Pull toward a consistent torso point, with a quiet torso and controlled return.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Avoid forceful torso swinging or painful range.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Keep the chest supported and pull elbows back with control.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Choose a bench angle and range that feel comfortable.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Pull toward the upper face with elbows out and a controlled return.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Keep load modest and avoid forcing shoulder range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Stay stacked through the torso and press in a controlled path.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a supported or alternative press if overhead range is painful.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Raise with control and keep the shoulder away from the ear.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a comfortable range and reduce load if the shoulder is painful.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.cue: Keep the upper arm mostly still and lower under control.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Avoid swinging and use a grip that does not aggravate the elbow.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Keep palms facing inward, elbows near your sides, and lower slowly.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a comfortable grip and stop if elbow pain increases.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
exercises.cue: Keep your upper arms behind the torso and lift without swinging your shoulders.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use a comfortable bench angle and avoid a painful shoulder or elbow range.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.cue: Keep the upper arms steady and lower only as far as your shoulders and elbows allow comfortably.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Switch to pressdowns if the overhead position causes shoulder or elbow discomfort.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
exercises.cue: Keep elbows close to the body and finish each repetition with control.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Avoid painful elbow range and excessive body sway.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.cue: Create a long straight line and breathe without letting the lower back sag.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Stop if it provokes symptoms. Choose a simpler core option if needed.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Move slowly while keeping the torso controlled and breathing normally.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Reduce the range if control or comfort changes.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.cue: Use a stable stance and lower under control while keeping balance through the front foot.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use support or reduce range if balance or joint comfort limits you.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Keep ribs and pelvis controlled, then squeeze at the top without overextending.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Pad the bar and adjust setup if the movement is uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull Up
exercises.cue: Start from a controlled hang, pull elbows down, and avoid kicking.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use enough assistance to maintain shoulder comfort and control.

exercises.name: Push Up
exercises.cue: Keep a stable trunk and lower as one controlled unit.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Raise the hands or choose another press if the range is painful.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.cue: Use a pace and incline that allow controlled breathing and safe footing.
exercises.pain_guardrail: Use conservative settings and stop for chest pain, dizziness, or concerning symptoms.

base_rules.progression: When all prescribed repetitions are completed with target RIR and stable technique for two sessions, make the smallest practical load increase or add one repetition.

programme_templates.name: 01 Build: Four-Day Hypertrophy
programme_templates.schedule: 4 days per week, upper lower split

base_rules.progression: Use double progression within the stated range. Add load only after the top of the range is achieved with target RIR and consistent form.

programme_templates.name: 01 Consistency: Three-Day Strength and Activity Support
programme_templates.schedule: 3 full-body strength sessions plus optional low-impact walking

base_rules.progression: Progress conservatively. A completed session and repeatable routine have priority over maximal fatigue.

programme_templates.name: 01 Arms: Biceps + Triceps
programme_templates.schedule: One arms session per week, with at least a rest day before repeating

base_rules.progression: Repeat the load until all sets reach the top of the rep range with control, then increase by the smallest practical amount.

programme_templates.name: 01 Biceps Focus
programme_templates.schedule: One biceps-focused session per week; allow recovery before repeating

base_rules.progression: Keep technique consistent. When all sets reach the upper rep target, increase load by the smallest practical amount.

modes.reduced_demand: Remove one accessory movement or one set, preserve a meaningful core session, target RIR 3-4.
modes.standard: Follow the base template, target programme RIR.
modes.push: Add at most one permitted accessory set or choose the top of an existing set range. Never override pain, major recovery concern, or a beginner cap.
modes.conservative: Use the low end of set ranges, target RIR 3-4, and shorten conditioning.
